Conbercept monkey CNV track, engagement: AURORA (doi:10.1016/j.ophtha.2014.03.026) and PHOENIX report central retinal thickness reductions, a downstream counterpart to monkey CNV leakage; no engagement entry exists for this track.

RGX-314 track (draft note says no admissible model source): Ding 2019 JCI (doi:10.1172/jci129085) rat model, RGX-314 Fab expression suppressed VEGF-induced vascular leakage; patient side Campochiaro 2024 Lancet phase 1/2a (doi:10.1016/S0140-6736(24)00310-6), aqueous RGX-314 protein and CRT/injection burden. Engagement (proximal) and efficacy comparisons possible.

Abicipar in-silico PK track (rabbit ocular PK scaled to human): EMA/415176/2020 states 'the human model again fitted well against the measured abicipar concentrations in serum and aqueous humor from patients' (comparison_stated; likely retrodiction since human data used in scaling) for the dose cell.
RGX-314 suprachoroidal NHP/pig expression (Ding 2019 JCI, doi:10.1172/JCI129085) vs suprachoroidal phase 2 ALTITUDE/AAVIATE patient aqueous protein (REGENXBIO releases); no track.
rule_questions: Does an uncontrolled phase 2 primary endpoint (change from baseline, AURORA) count as the first efficacy comparison, ahead of a sham-controlled phase 3?
When a model predicts only activity vs vehicle, does failing non-inferiority vs an active comparator (PANDA-1/2) leave the track unchanged, as the draft assumes?
Safety silence when the species showed the harm in one study but it was dismissed (monkey IND study: ocular inflammation in vehicle and low doses, not dose-limiting): miss (contra) or partial?
Is a margin 'stated before the trial' when it exists only in unpublished sponsor reports dated before phase 3 and made public in the later regulator review (brolucizumab, abicipar dose entries)?

RGX-314 rat model: first public date (Ding 2019) postdates public patient protein data (2018), though the rat work likely supported the 2017 IND. Does the publication date or the presumed (unsourced) IND date decide retrodiction?

PANDA-1/2: the sponsor's April 2021 notice also cites pandemic disruption of the trial; does a sponsor's mention of operational conditions the model never tested make an efficacy failure untested rather than contra?
